Callout.Name: Hostage Rescue - Staged Assault
Callout.Message: Hostage held inside a business premises.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects and at least one hostage.

Script.Line: Nobody has to be hurt here. Nobody.
The door is locked and I have the key.
We are coming out. Keep your people back and we are coming out.

Stages.Stage: Entry teams are set on both doors.
They are at the back door with the hostage.
Hostage out and both suspects detained.

Lines.Approach: Two of them, at least one hostage, and they have stopped answering the phone.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
